guard: the completion check runs ahead of EVERY verdict, not only ahead of the red one
completionMarker: an absolute --config path is read where it is

mutations.name: the completion check is disabled outright
mutations.expectRed: a run that never reaches the suite's end is INCONCLUSIVE, not KILLED
mutations.note: Disabling the check outright is BROADER than the cell it would like to name: in a fail-fast suite the earlier incomplete-run cell fires first, so this is graded on that one and the clean-exit direction is graded by the ordering mutation below, which is the narrow one.

mutations.name: THE ORDERING: the completion check applies only to a red run, as it did before
mutations.expectRed: a CLEAN exit that never reached the region is INCONCLUSIVE, not SURVIVED

mutations.name: a run that printed nothing is blamed on the assertion instead
mutations.expectRed: a run with NO OUTPUT is named as never having started
